== Original card list citation ==
The [https://web.archive.org/web/20081021010807/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/index.html archived Premiere Light Side card list] records [[Luke Skywalker]] as Character: Rebel, R1. The citation supports only the catalog title, side, listed type and rarity. The archived card image and any starred strategy link have not been checked. This citation does not verify printed text, strategy, lore, icons, statistics, other references or version claims. All existing article data and citations remain unchanged. == Shared Versions navigator pilot, 13 November 2026 ==
The sixteen existing publication articles in the Premiere Luke Skywalker family now use [[Template:Card versions/Luke Skywalker (Premiere)]] in their Versions infobox cells. The navigator groups Decipher, Virtual Original, Virtual Legacy and Virtual Modern publications and highlights the article being viewed. Edit the shared family template once to update the list across its member articles.

Article images, text, lore, statistics and identifiers were preserved. Verified archive links were added to existing citations. A temporary shared-label test propagated across all four eras without changing any of the sixteen article revisions, then the label was restored. Pre-edit snapshots and guarded rollback instructions are recorded in the team story. Bill authorized the reversible pilot and will review it before a wider migration.
